method: Direct SERP observation via web search. NO keyword volume data is available and none is estimated. Every observedVolume is null by policy.
rule: OBSERVED SERP COMPOSITION is recorded here. INFERRED query opportunity lives in docs/seo/query-intent-map.md and is labelled as inference.

observations.query: sell my house fast Boise Idaho cash home buyers
observations.reading: The head commercial query is saturated with established local direct buyers, several claiming 15+ years and BBB ratings. Zero informational, government or guide results appear. A new domain has no realistic near-term path onto this SERP on content alone — which is consistent with the Boise Bath measurement that commercial local pages on a new domain earn nothing, and with the decision to build knowledge pillars before city pillars.
observations.competitorNotes: Claims observed across these sites are near-identical: no fees, no repairs, no commissions, close in 7 days, offer in 24 hours. Differentiation on message is effectively zero, which is where verifiable Idaho-specific evidence becomes the opening.
